passwordReset.subject: Password Reset Request
passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset your password. Click the button below to create a new password:
passwordReset.orCopy: Or copy and paste this link into your browser:
passwordReset.oneTimeUse: This link can only be used once
passwordReset.ignoreWarning: If you didn't request this, please ignore this email
passwordReset.noRequestInfo: If you didn't request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email. Your password will remain unchanged.
passwordReset.footer: This is an automated email, please do not reply.

welcome.subject: Welcome to NestJS Starter
welcome.thankYou: Thank you for registering! We're excited to have you on board.
welcome.accountCreated: Your account has been successfully created and you can now access all features of our platform.
welcome.support: If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to reach out to our support team.
welcome.footer: This is an automated email, please do not reply.

emailVerification.subject: Verify Your Email Address
emailVerification.thankYou: Thank you for registering! To complete your registration and activate your account, please use the verification code below:
emailVerification.enterCode: Enter this code in the verification page to activate your account.
emailVerification.mustVerify: You must verify your email to access all features
emailVerification.expiryWarning: This verification code will expire in 24 hours
emailVerification.requestNew: If the code expires, you can request a new one
emailVerification.ignoreWarning: If you didn't create an account, you can safely ignore this email.
emailVerification.footer: This is an automated email, please do not reply.
